name: Woodbrook House
address: Woodbrook House, Kilmurray, Clane, Co. Kildare
bedsNote: Two en-suite doubles on the ground floor, four upstairs; plus a detached ~1,000 sq ft mews (kitchen, shower room, two lofts)
heating: Oil-fired central heating, plus a wood-burning stove
tagline: An ivy-covered 1850s house, extended in 2002, on 3 acres with paddocks and a sand arena, across the road from Donadea Forest Park, 6 km from Clane.

pros.text: Two en-suite bedrooms on the ground floor
pros.detail: Bedroom 1 (5.3 × 4.0 m, shower en suite) and Bedroom 2 (5.3 × 4.7 m, bath en suite) come before the 'First Floor' heading in the agent's room list, next to a ground-floor WC with shower.
Two paddocks, a ~600 m² sand arena, three loose boxes and a landscaped garden; Donadea Forest Park's trails are across the road.
10.7 × 5.1 m kitchen/living, 10.7 × 6.6 m games room with bar and sauna, 7.4 × 3.8 m stone dining room, plus a lounge, TV room and office.

pros.text: Four bathrooms plus a separate mews
pros.detail: Two en suites, a family bathroom and a shower WC in the house; the ~1,000 sq ft mews has its own kitchen and shower room for guests or letting (its two lofts are up a spiral stair).
CHI at Tallaght is about 25 km in a straight line (about 35 km by road via Clane and the N7); Crumlin is the alternative.
Kilcock has 10 weekday trains to Connolly (06:42–21:27, 43–62 min); Maynooth, 12 km away, has far more.
Staplestown NS (co-ed, ~110 pupils) is 1.2 km away; the house is in St Farnan's (Prosperous) catchment, and Clongowes Wood (fee-paying) is 4.7 km.
BuyerIQ shows 387 Mb full fibre for this Eircode.

cons.detail: €3,013/m², about 2.35 times the €500k line, with €13,500 stamp duty. It has been listed for 121 days (since 27 Jun) with no price change found, which gives some room to negotiate.

cons.text: BER D1, oil heating, 390 m² to heat
cons.detail: 238.59 kWh/m²/yr, about 93,000 kWh/yr modelled. As a rough guess, oil costs €7–10k a year and a heat-pump and insulation retrofit costs €60–100k before grants.
1850s stone house, 2002 extension, mews, stables, arena, paddocks, hot tub, sauna and bar: years of upkeep and running costs before any change.
Neither the listing nor the features mention them; a rural site like this usually has a septic tank or treatment unit, and possibly a well.

No inspection or progression figures were found for Staplestown NS, St Farnan's or Scoil Mhuire Clane, and the Clane–Prosperous area is oversubscribed for first-year places; only Clongowes (fee-paying) has a strong record.
BuyerIQ (OPW NIFM, indicative) maps a river flood zone about 0.3 km from the address; get a flood-cover quote.

cons.text: Front wall on the road, farmyard nearby
cons.detail: From above, the house fronts a local road with a row of four or five houses alongside to the west and a farmyard about 200 m west; fields to the south and the forest to the north.

questions: Can you send a floor plan? We'd like to confirm that Bedrooms 1 and 2 are on the ground floor, and whether the 390 m² (Daft) or 4,500 sq ft (MyHome) includes the mews.
Is the water mains or a well, and is the sewage a septic tank or a treatment unit? How old is it, and has it been inspected?
Does the mews have planning permission as a habitable unit, and is there a certificate of compliance for the c.2002 extension?
What does the house use in oil a year, and are there any quotes for a heat pump or insulation?
BuyerIQ maps a river flood zone about 0.3 km away. Has the house, the land or the road ever flooded, and does the vendor hold flood cover?

ai.why: A beautiful c.1850 house on 3 acres with two ground-floor en-suite bedrooms by Donadea Forest, but €1.175m to buy and a lot of house, grounds and arena to keep up; well past the budget.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; not stated (lived-in house with CCTV and electric gates).

water.detail: Not stated: could be mains or a private well; ask.

sewer.detail: Septic tank or treatment unit likely; not stated, and there's no public sewer this far out.

internet.detail: Full fibre likely: BuyerIQ shows 387 Mb full fibre at this address; the listing doesn't mention broadband.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Two: Bedroom 1 (5.3 × 4.0 m, shower en suite) and Bedroom 2 (5.3 × 4.7 m, bath en suite) are listed before the 'First Floor' heading; no floor plan is published, so the layout is from the room list.
